name: tv_samsung
description: Control Samsung TV: power, volume, mute, home, hdmi1-4, netflix. Requires SAMSUNG_TV_IP on home hub.

name: tv_jvc
description: Control JVC TV via HDMI-CEC or IR bridge: power, volume, input_hdmi1.

name: speak_phonon
description: Speak text with on-device Phonon TTS through the home hub (offline, English 31m).

name: launch_game
description: Launch a game or big-picture mode: steam_bigpicture, steam_app:<id>, moonlight, or samsung_app:<name>.

name: scene_lounge
description: Run a named lounge scene: movie, gaming, off — dims TVs and sets inputs per home.env scenes.

name: apple_tv
description: Apple TV remote: play, pause, home, menu, directions, select, volume, power. Uses pyatv or Home Assistant.

name: apple_device
description: Apple ecosystem on Mac hub: run Shortcuts by name, Music play/pause, system volume.

name: list_cameras
description: List configured IP cameras from cameras.json.

name: camera_snapshot
description: Fetch latest JPEG snapshot from a camera id (for lounge app preview).

name: jellyfin_status
description: Ping Jellyfin server (lossless FLAC library) — System/Info/Public.

name: launch_music
description: Return Jellyfin web URL or Jellybox connect instructions (jellyfin, jellybox).
